trust_decision.summary: Whether a request to /mockoon-admin* may read or mutate mock state, env vars and transaction logs is decided by nothing at the pinned commit: the shared admin middleware only sets wildcard CORS headers and calls next(); the fix adds a bearer-token check plus an origin allowlist in the same middleware chain, and redacts logs at the output points.

landing_point.why: The summary names @mockoon/commons-server, the admin API and wildcard CORS; this one middleware is the only place that emits 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' for /mockoon-admin*.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP route under /mockoon-admin* (CORS allowlist, OPTIONS termination, bearer auth middleware; fix.diff:820-904)
POST/PUT/PATCH /mockoon-admin/env-vars (prefix forced on writes, 403 on empty prefix; fix.diff:936-969)
MockoonServer.createRequestListener (public API) passes token and CORS origins to createAdminEndpoint (fix.diff:1179-1180)
CLI/serverless --log-transaction logs via listenServerEvents (public API); redaction set widened (fix.diff:998-1119)
createLoggerInstance (public API): auto-generated token redacted from file transport (fix.diff:720-772)
MockoonServerless constructor / requestListener / awsHandler / firebaseApp / netlifyHandler (fix.diff:2142-2171)
desktop app environment start (Electron main process) plus token display in renderer settings (fix.diff:15-73, 105-212)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/commons-server/src/libs/server/events-listeners.ts:15-25 (separate header-redaction implementation for --log-transaction logs, only covers authorization/proxy-authorization; fix replaces it with shared redactHeaders, fix.diff:998-1119). The serverless wrapper packages/serverless/src/libs/serverless.ts:36-59 is a second, wrapper-kind out-of-scope site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the admin API and CORS; CLI/serverless transaction logs are the operator's own local stdout/file, and Authorization is already masked there, so widening that list (cookie, x-api-key) looks like a separate logging feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: User-defined mock routes must keep their environment CORS behaviour (setCors answers OPTIONS '/*' with environment headers) and must stay unauthenticated; GET env-var reads must keep auto-prefixing; the desktop Logs tab must keep unredacted headers (comment at fix.diff:1192-1203); the SSE endpoint must accept a ?token= query because EventSource cannot send headers.

OPTIONS preflight from an allowed origin, a non-allowed origin and no origin (fix.diff:854-861)
CORS origins as array, CSV string, or '*' opt-in (fix.diff:830-837, 536-546)
env-var write key with prefix, without prefix, and empty configured prefix (fix.diff:941-962)
sensitive headers in request and response, Authorization with and without scheme (fix.diff:1204-1247)
token from option, from MOCKOON_ADMIN_API_TOKEN env var, or auto-generated (fix.diff:15-47, 1146-1151, 2142-2149)

O7_producer.where: packages/commons-server/src/libs/server/server.ts:634 (CreateTransaction maps the raw request/response, including all secret headers, into stored transactionLogs at server.ts:638)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /mockoon-admin/env-vars/:key returns any process env var when the configured prefix is empty; the fix enforces the prefix on writes only
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Reads are now behind the bearer token, and an empty prefix is a documented operator opt-out ('Pass an empty string to disable it').
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point, about 60 lines below

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second SSE or long-poll log stream registered on a different prefix (e.g. a websocket upgrade path for admin events) that the /mockoon-admin* middleware does not cover
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: server.ts:875-920 already has a separate websocket upgrade handler that bypasses Express middleware, so a maintainer adding live log streaming over WS would skip the app.use() auth chain.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a public MockoonServer method (e.g. getTransactionLogs exposed through a helper route or the serverless handler) that returns transactionLogs without redactTransaction
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Logs are stored raw at server.ts:638 and redacted only at the admin outputs, so any new consumer of getLogs re-opens the leak.

O9_family: missing authentication + permissive CORS on a management API (CWE-306/352/942), with sensitive-data exposure in logs (CWE-732)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop or restrict the wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin in the admin middleware (CORS-only fix), leaving the admin API unauthenticated, OPTIONS falling through to the environment's setCors, SSE/logs unredacted and env-var writes unrestricted.

The desktop renderer receives unredacted transactions over local IPC by design (fix.diff:1200-1202).
